entities.summary: Clive Berrangè van Ryneveld was a South African cricketer who played in 19 Test matches between 1951 and 1958. He was the son of Reginald Clive Berrangè van Ryneveld (1891–1969) and Maria Alfreda Blanckenberg (1900–1994). Before his death in 2018, he was the oldest living South African cricket captain.
